description: Implementation of BatchApiService handling batch requests, including transaction management, request processing, recursive execution, error handling, and response aggregation in the Fineract project.

classes.name: BatchApiServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing batch request processing with transaction management, recursive execution, and error handling.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithoutEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes batch requests with each request in a separate transaction.

methods.name: handleBatchRequestsWithEnclosingTransaction
methods.description: Processes batch requests within a single enclosing transaction.

methods.name: handleBatchRequests
methods.description: Core method to handle batch requests, managing transaction scope based on parameter.

methods.name: callInTransaction
methods.description: Executes batch requests within a transaction with retry logic and error handling.

methods.name: handleRequestNodes
methods.description: Builds request tree and executes requests recursively, collecting responses.

methods.name: callRequestRecursive
methods.description: Recursively executes a request and its child requests, handling success and failure.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes individual batch request using command strategy, with preprocessing and error handling.

methods.name: runPreprocessors
methods.description: Runs preprocessing steps on a batch request.

methods.name: runPreprocessor
methods.description: Recursively applies a list of preprocessors to a batch request.

methods.name: parentRequestFailedRecursive
methods.description: Sets child requests to error state if parent request fails.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs a BatchResponse representing an error, based on exception and request.

methods.name: buildOrThrowErrorResponse
methods.description: Builds error response or throws exception if in a transaction.

methods.name: buildErrorResponses
methods.description: Generates error responses for exceptions during batch processing.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a BatchResponse for an error with specific details.
